result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's a particularly good all-rounder for managing invoices, expenses, GST, bank reconciliation and payroll.

However, the best option depends on the size and type of your business.

## My top 5 accounting software recommendations

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank reconciliation.
- GST and BAS management.
- Payroll and superannuation features.
- Connects with hundreds of business apps.
- Great for businesses planning to grow.

Australian plans start around A\$37/month.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for Australian businesses)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features.
- BAS and GST management.
- Good for businesses with employees.
- Particularly useful for established businesses.

Business plans from around A\$35/month.

[Visit MYOB](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Easy invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Good integrations.
- Suitable for smaller businesses and contractors.

[Visit QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Books**

(Best budget option)

- Good value for smaller businesses.
- Automates invoices and expenses.
- Integrates with other Zoho products.
- Has a free plan for eligible businesses.

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

---

![Australian Wave accounting alternative | Rounded](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/iHTtuzfR8afbUEsOjANr7BZNtUaTCbI-w6hfNd2ZhvSmWv3z_Zvt00omzgbR_d7wj31enSdNcHeFhS2u3r8tS9sTIjjdCP1IzsOGdZLYvJeXIDYspK9sCEvR9R3F9LrBksX2QaPuFchF_4cDBhe3CGWQmXc8CTsjGg1d1BCTyul3jvIxZUfAFTLQydw-K0Yk?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Rounded**

(Best for sole traders)

- Simple and easy to use.
- Designed specifically for Australian sole traders.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- GST and BAS support on applicable plans.

[Visit Rounded](https://rounded.com.au/)

These recommendations reflect Australian-focused comparisons published in 2026. ## Which one would I choose?

| Business type | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Small business with employees | Xero or MYOB |
| Sole trader | Rounded |
| Trades and contractors | Xero or MYOB |
| Retail business | MYOB or Xero |
| Consulting business | Xero |
| Very tight budget | Zoho Books |
